verdicts.reason: A: the mountain/hiker illustration is pushed against the left edge and stops at a hard vertical line around x=440, leaving the right half of the bottom empty and lopsided. The cross is also jammed between the invite copy and the dates, out of its original order, and a large dead gap sits above 'Worship & Bible Study'. B: the text stack keeps the original order and spacing and is well centred. Its flaw is that the illustration is centred but no longer full-bleed: the forest ends in hard vertical cuts on both sides, so the art reads as a cropped rectangle floating in pale margins.
